steps.reading: Write conflict: gateway logs 'Lock not available error during transaction' and maps it to 112 WriteConflict 'canceling statement due to lock timeout' (~25 ms, so the gateway runs the transaction with a very short PostgreSQL lock_timeout). Idle transaction: PostgreSQL itself logs 'FATAL: terminating connection due to idle-in-transaction timeout' exactly 30 s after the last statement (20:08:13.5 -> 20:08:43.506; 20:08:49.5 -> 20:09:19.519), the gateway pool logs 'deadpool.postgres: Connection error: db error', and the client's next statement fails with code 1 InternalError 'Non db postgres error: connection closed' followed by 'Failed to drop a transaction / Failed to roll back abandoned transaction: connection closed'.

summary.write_conflict: Second transaction's update on the same document fails immediately (about 25 ms, before the first commits) with {ok:0, code:112, codeName:'WriteConflict', errmsg:'canceling statement due to lock timeout'} and NO errorLabels field at all (verified on the raw wire reply). So drivers' withTransaction/TransientTransactionError retry does not trigger; apps must retry code 112 themselves. The first transaction commits fine; the failed transaction's later abortTransaction returns 251 NoSuchTransaction 'Cannot continue transaction N'.
summary.readConcern: snapshot in a transaction -> 115 CommandNotSupported "'Snapshot' read concern is not supported" (no errorLabels); majority and local accepted (find + commit ok).
summary.commit_twice: commitTransaction is idempotent: second (and w:'majority' retry-form) commitTransaction return {ok:1}. abortTransaction after commit -> 256 TransactionCommitted 'Transaction N already committed'. abortTransaction twice -> second returns 251 NoSuchTransaction; commitTransaction after abort -> 251 NoSuchTransaction. pymongo itself refuses abort-after-commit client-side (InvalidOperation) before reaching the server.
summary.idle_timeout: After 36 s idle the next write in the transaction fails with {ok:0, code:1, codeName:'InternalError', errmsg:'[ActivityId=...] An unexpected internal error has occurred.'} with no errorLabels; commitTransaction on that session returns the same code 1 InternalError; a subsequent abortTransaction returns 251 NoSuchTransaction. Container logs show PostgreSQL killed the backend with 'terminating connection due to idle-in-transaction timeout' at exactly 30 s. The expired transaction's writes were not applied (final document unchanged). This is NOT the clean 251 NoSuchTransaction that issue #756 anticipates.
summary.scope: All observed on documentdb-local (gateway buildInfo version 7.0.0, image ghcr.io/documentdb/documentdb/documentdb-local:latest, pymongo 4.20.1); evidence about the open-source engine/gateway only, not proof of managed Azure DocumentDB behaviour.
